name: mcpmake-cli
description: mcpmake — generate MCP servers you own from any API. CLI (mcpmake) + shared library (@mcpmake/core).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @mcpmake/core && npm run build --workspace mcpmake
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @mcpmake/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @mcpmake/core && npm run typecheck --workspace mcpmake
scripts.prepublish:all: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && MCPMAKE_E2E=1 npm run test:e2e && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.publish:all: npm run prepublish:all && npm publish --workspace @mcpmake/core && npm publish --workspace mcpmake
